finalists.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
finalists.why: This candidate has the strongest for evidence, including classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion and proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells, with no against evidence.

finalists.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
finalists.why: This candidate has some for evidence, including negative results with Alcian blue and mucicarmine stains, but is limited by lack of direct comparison to other candidates within its group.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is decided by the presence of malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, and the proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells into the dermis, which are specific and decisive findings in the vignette.

a yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule was discovered on the central lower eyelid without margin involvement
